text:
Maya: it's raining and i need a 90-min-or-less movie + one album to finish the night. hit me with your favs :cloud_rain:
Alex: Movie: "Frances Ha" (2012) — light, 86 mins, great soundtrack. Album: 'For Emma, Forever Ago' by Bon Iver. cozy.
Jamal: If you want something weirder — Movie: 'Primer' (81 min) — brain-bend. Album: 'LP1' by FKA twigs for mood.
Sophie: Documentary rec: 'The Barkley Marathons' short version is wild and like 45 mins. also, 'Bedroom Community' playlist on Spotify for chill electronic => https://open.spotify.com/playlist/0example
Theo: Movie that's a comfort watch: 'The Secret of Kells' (75 mins) — gorgeous animation, relaxing. Album: 'Grizzly Bear - Veckatimest' for warm textures.
Maya: ooh Secret of Kells is 10/10 on visuals. adding that to my list. anyone got a guilty-pleasure show under 3 eps?
Alex: 'Blue Planet II' episode clips are short and oddly soothing. also 'Quickies' podcast ep recs but not a show.
Jamal: guilty-pleasure mini: 'The End of the F***ing World' first two eps are punchy.
Sophie: quick book rec instead: 'The Night Circus' — not short but dreamy if you want to read after credits.
WeekendDJ: Playlist queued: "Rainy Window Mix" — 12 tracks (indie, ambient, light electronica). Reaction: :notes:
Theo: also vote: album to pair with Secret of Kells — Grizzly Bear vs Sigur Rós?
Maya: sigur rós for the foggy vibe, grizzly bear if you want warm voices.
Alex: voted sigur rós (:thumbsup:)
Jamal: grizzly bear from me (:heart:).
Sophie: okay democratic compromise — start with Sigur Rós, switch to Grizzly Bear during closing credits.
Maya: perfect. thanks y'all. sending animated gif of a cat in a raincoat :cat_with_rain:
